title: Warmly Spiced Kenyan Sloe Berries Tagine
description: A traditional Kenyan dish featuring sloe berries, shio cure, and Mediterranean friendly spices, perfect for a comforting meal on a sick day, with a mustardy and crumbly texture.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sloe berries, shio cure, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, covered, for 20 minutes.
Uncover and continue cooking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the sloe berries have broken down and the mixture has thickened.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
